int_name: COBBS CREEK PKWY & S EDGEWOOD ST

result.summary: The environment is extremely hostile to pedestrians, lacking any dedicated infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crossings. The road design, with wide lanes and no traffic calming, suggests a high-speed corridor that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk on the unpaved shoulder or within the travel lanes due to the complete absence of sidewalks.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes and lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing the risk of severe injury in a collision.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian warning signs to designate safe crossing points and alert drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, sweeping roadway curve that likely encourages high vehicle speeds and lacks marked crossings. While a sidewalk is present, the absence of pedestrian signals, curb ramps, and refuge islands creates a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The large radius of the curb at the intersection allows vehicles to maintain high speeds while turning, increasing risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to tighten the turning radius, slowing vehicles and shortening the pedestrian crossing distance.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a wide main road lacking marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present along the residential buildings, the crossing environment is unprotected and requires pedestrians to traverse a significant distance without dedicated infrastructure.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two roads.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main road increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main asphalt roadway in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental style) marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a high-speed roadway environment that is completely hostile to pedestrians, lacking any sidewalks, crossings, or safe shoulders. A continuous guardrail along the edge of the road further endangers pedestrians by removing any potential escape route from the travel lanes into the adjacent wooded area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The complete absence of sidewalks or designated walking areas forces pedestrians to walk directly in high-speed traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the guardrail

hazards.name: Entrapment by Guardrail
hazards.description: The metal guardrail prevents pedestrians from exiting the roadway into the adjacent wooded area, effectively trapping them in the path of vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Running parallel to the road on the right side

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a separated, paved sidewalk to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians away from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures or lower speed limits to reduce the risk and severity of potential collisions in this corridor.
